Advertisement for the post of Guest Faculty (02)
Applications are invited for appointment of Guest Faculty (02) in the Centre for
Medical Physics to be filled purely on temporary basis for the odd semester of the
academic session 2026-27.
Essential Qualifications:
(i) Good academic record as defined by the University with at least 55% marks
(50% for SC/ST/Physically & Visually Handicapped) or an equivalent grade in a
point scale wherever grading system is followed at the Master’s degree level in
Medical Physics/Physics (M.Sc. degree in Physics with Nuclear Physics or
Radiation Physics) from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an
accredited foreign University.
(ii) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate should have either
cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC/CSIR OR
should have obtained Ph. D. Degree in the relevant subject.
(iii) NET shall not be required for such disciplines for which NET is not conducted.
The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to
undertake that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial
assistance from any agency and will do the same till they are teaching in the Centre
for Medical Physics as a Guest Faculty.
All the applicants are advised to bring their original documents and other relevant
documents for verifications during the interview. The application forms for the post
of Assistant Professor is available at the website (https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/show-
forms.php).
The applications must reach the undersigned in the office by 6th August, 2026 upto
5.00 p.m.
The candidate must appear for the Interview on 7th August 2026 at 3 p.m. in person
before the members of the selection committee in the office of the Chairperson,
Centre for Medical Physics, Sector-25, Panjab University, Chandigarh-160014. No
TA/DA will be paid for interview.
-Sd-
Dr. Vivek Kumar
Chairperson
